summary: Full verification of iteration-24 features: Revenue Masking (technician-only), Weather Alerts banner, Weather Risk filter+RISK column. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. critical_code_review_comments: FINANCIAL_MASK_ROLES is a hard-coded set in fleet.py; recommend moving to a shared RBAC helper to avoid drift as more masked routes are added (e.g., future analytics endpoints).
SitesTable RISK column shows 'Clear' badge sometimes but rendering uses a separate branch — consider a single RISK_STYLE map for consistency (already close).

GET /api/fleet/sites?limit=500 without weather params correctly skips weather work (verified <20s including cold-cache path). Recommend adding a lightweight response header (e.g. X-Weather-Enriched: 0/1) for observability.
